生成された動画：=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:

Use the provided Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's exact facial identity, facial structure, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, sword design, overall silhouette, and grounded warrior appearance.

Riven must remain unmistakably the same character throughout the entire video.

This scene takes place years after Riven's childhood.

Riven has spent many years practicing swordsmanship under her Father's guidance.

Her original character design must remain unchanged.

Do not redesign her costume.

Do not change her clothing or armor design.

Do not change her hairstyle.

Do not change her body proportions.

Do not replace or redesign her sword.

Riven is now highly capable with the sword because of years of practice.

However, she has not yet experienced real warfare.

Her technique should feel disciplined and practiced rather than battle-hardened.

Her movement must remain grounded and human.

No supernatural abilities.

No magical effects.

Riven does not speak in this scene.


RIVEN'S FATHER:

Use the provided Father reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve his exact facial identity, facial structure, hair, beard, body proportions, clothing, and overall silhouette.

He is the same former warrior who raised Riven and taught her swordsmanship.

Years of training together have created a quiet understanding between them.

He no longer needs to physically correct Riven's stance or grip.

He mainly observes.

His movements remain calm, economical, and controlled.

His relationship with Riven should feel familiar and natural.

He is not a strict military instructor.

He is her father.


=== DIALOGUE LOCK — STRICT ===

There is only ONE spoken word in the entire video.

The Father looks directly toward Riven and says in natural ENGLISH:

"Again."

This is the ONLY spoken dialogue.

Riven does not speak.

The soldiers do not speak.

The villagers do not speak.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No background conversations.

Do not generate Chinese or Mandarin speech.

Do not generate Vietnamese speech.

Do not generate any non-English speech.

Do not add any other dialogue.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK — STRICT ===

Use the provided Riven Village / Home reference image as the strict environment reference.

The scene takes place in the familiar dirt-and-grass training area beside Riven's family cottage.

Preserve the recognizable:

family cottage,
old tree,
chopping block,
stacked firewood,
dirt ground,
grass,
village road,
surrounding homes,
green valley,
distant mountains.

This is the same peaceful village where Riven grew up.

The environment is calm and safe.

Soft natural daylight.

Gentle mountain wind.

Subtle chimney smoke.

Quiet rural activity in the distance.

A dirt road passing through the village must remain naturally visible from the training area.

Later in the scene, a small group of traveling soldiers passes along this road.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Grounded physical interaction.

Realistic sword weight and metal physics.

Realistic footwork and body balance.

Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Maintain strict facial identity, costume consistency, sword consistency, and body proportions throughout the whole video.

Natural cinematic camera movement.

Use restrained, deliberate camera movement.

Keep Riven clearly readable.

Avoid excessive cuts.

Avoid rapid montage.

Avoid exaggerated slow motion.

Avoid supernatural movement.

Avoid flashy magical effects.

Avoid acrobatics.

Avoid spinning attacks.

Avoid exaggerated sword choreography.

This is NOT a battle.

This is NOT a training montage.

The scene takes place as one continuous moment.

Riven is already skilled.

Do not portray her as a beginner.

Do not have her fall down.

Do not have the Father physically teach her basic sword handling.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.

Audio:

gentle mountain wind,
distant birds,
quiet village ambience,
boots shifting against dirt,
realistic sword movement through air,
Riven's controlled breathing,
subtle movement of clothing and equipment,
later, distant horse hooves and quiet military equipment sounds.

No dramatic background music.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Open with Riven already practicing swordsmanship in the dirt-and-grass area beside her family cottage.

The audience receives no verbal explanation of how much time has passed.

Riven's adult appearance and practiced swordsmanship naturally communicate that many years have passed since her childhood.

Her Father stands nearby quietly observing.

Riven performs a short sequence of grounded, controlled sword movements.

She is clearly skilled.

Her stance is stable.

Her footwork is practiced.

Her grip is confident.

Her movements show years of repetition.

Do not make the choreography flashy.

During a more difficult transition, Riven makes one small technical mistake.

She immediately recognizes it.

She stops herself and remains standing.

Her Father notices.

He calmly looks toward her and says:

"Again."

Riven understands immediately.

She resets her stance without speaking.

She prepares to repeat the movement.

Before she begins, distant horse hooves become audible from the village road.

Riven pauses.

Her attention shifts toward the sound.

A small disciplined group of soldiers is passing through the village.

They are not attacking.

They are not threatening anyone.

They are simply traveling through.

Riven watches them with quiet fascination.

From her perspective, these soldiers represent the wider world beyond her isolated village.

She watches their disciplined movement, armor, equipment, and weapons.

Then she looks at her own sword.

Then back toward the soldiers.

Her Father notices the way she is watching them.

Instead of watching the soldiers, he watches his daughter.

He understands that something has changed in her attention.

Neither character speaks.

Riven does not follow the soldiers.

End quietly.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — YEARS OF PRACTICE

Begin with an extreme close-up of Riven's hands firmly holding the sword from her provided reference image.

Preserve the exact sword design.

Her grip is confident and familiar.

The sword moves out of the close composition.

Transition naturally into a medium-wide shot.

Reveal Adult Riven training in the dirt-and-grass area beside her family cottage.

She performs a short sequence of practical sword movements.

One controlled diagonal cut.

A clean recovery.

A deliberate change in foot position.

Another controlled movement.

Keep everything physically believable.

The sword has real weight.

Riven moves with the weapon rather than fighting against its momentum.

Her movements communicate years of practice.

She is skilled, but she is not showing off.

Riven attempts a slightly more difficult transition.

One foot lands at a slightly imperfect angle.

Her balance shifts subtly.

She immediately recognizes the mistake.

She stops the movement.

She does NOT fall.

She remains standing.

Riven looks briefly dissatisfied with herself.

Reveal her Father nearby.

He has been quietly observing.

He looks directly toward Riven.

In calm natural English, he says exactly:

"Again."

Riven looks toward him.

She does not answer.

There is no embarrassment.

There is no argument.

She understands exactly what he means.

Riven resets her feet.

She settles back into stance.

She raises the sword.

She prepares to repeat the movement.

Before she begins:

distant horse hooves.

Riven pauses.

Her eyes move toward the village road.

CUT.


Shot 2 — THE SOLDIERS

Begin from Riven's attention shifting toward the sound.

She lowers the sword slightly.

Reveal the village road beyond the training area.

A small disciplined group of soldiers is traveling through the peaceful village.

Some soldiers walk.

Some may travel on horseback.

Their armor and equipment are practical, worn, and grounded.

Their weapons are carried naturally.

Their movement is organized and disciplined.

They do not behave aggressively.

They do not threaten the villagers.

They do not stop to confront anyone.

Ordinary village life continues around them.

Do not portray the soldiers as sinister.

Do not use ominous imagery.

Do not suggest that they are villains.

From Riven's current perspective, they represent discipline, purpose, and a world beyond the village.

Return attention to Riven.

She watches silently.

Her training has completely stopped.

Her eyes follow the soldiers.

She notices their armor.

Their disciplined movement.

Their weapons.

The quiet confidence of people accustomed to traveling beyond the valley.

Riven remains still.

Do not have her speak.

CUT.


Shot 3 — BEYOND THE VILLAGE

Keep the pacing slow and observational.

The soldiers continue traveling farther along the village road.

Riven remains in the foreground holding her sword.

Her eyes follow them.

Briefly emphasize a soldier carrying a sword naturally while walking with the group.

Return to Riven.

Her gaze slowly moves downward.

She looks at the sword in her own hand.

Hold.

Do not add any magical effect.

Do not make the sword glow.

Nothing physical changes.

Riven simply studies it.

Then she slowly raises her eyes again.

She looks toward the departing soldiers.

Her expression should remain subtle.

No broad smile.

No exaggerated excitement.

No heroic expression.

What appears instead is quiet fascination.

For the first time, the life beyond her village feels tangible.

Shift attention toward her Father.

He is standing nearby.

The Father is no longer interested in watching the soldiers.

He is watching Riven.

He notices the way she looks at the departing group.

He notices her look at her own sword.

He understands what is beginning to form in her mind.

Do not have the Father speak.

Do not have Riven notice him watching.

The soldiers continue farther into the distance.

Gentle wind moves Riven's pale-blonde hair and clothing.

Riven remains standing with her sword.

She keeps watching the road.

Hold the quiet composition.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven stands in the familiar training area beside her family cottage.

She holds her sword.

Her training has stopped.

A small group of soldiers is traveling away along the village road.

Riven watches them silently.

She has become deeply interested in what they represent.

She has not made any verbal decision.

She has not joined them.

She has not followed them.

Her Father stands nearby.

He is watching Riven rather than the departing soldiers.

He understands her interest before she says anything.

Neither Riven nor her Father speaks.

End with Riven holding her sword and looking toward the road beyond her village.


=== MOOD ===

Warm.

Grounded.

Quietly ambitious.

Reflective.

Restrained.

The scene should communicate that many years have passed through Riven herself:

her adult appearance,
her physical confidence,
her disciplined swordsmanship,
and the familiar relationship between Riven and her Father.

Do not explain the time jump through dialogue.

Do not show Riven transforming from child to adult.

Do not show multiple ages.

Do not create a training montage.

The emotional progression should remain simple:

Riven trains
→ makes one small technical mistake
→ Father says "Again."
→ Riven resets
→ horse hooves interrupt the moment
→ soldiers pass through the village
→ Riven watches them
→ Riven looks at her own sword
→ Riven looks back toward the soldiers
→ Father quietly notices.

Do not add another story event.

Do not have Riven join the soldiers.

Do not have Riven announce that she wants to become a soldier.

Do not have the Father question her.

Do not portray the soldiers as villains.

End with possibility rather than decision.、16:9
